This '''Rebel pilot''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The pilot participated in a number of [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|historical]] training [[Flight simulator/Legends|simulations]] around the same [[Time/Legends|time]] as [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]].
